range: Video platforms at two in the morning, and any comment section with a pinned link.
field_marks: Cites a preprint that does not exist

confused_with.tell: The bleatkeeper trusts nothing; the algodemic trusts one chart he cannot read.

senses: A self-styled "independent researcher" and conspiracy theorist whose entire worldview is assembled from Facebook memes, fringe podcasts, and YouTube rabbit holes - connecting unrelated dots into a grand cabal while remaining completely oblivious to the fact that they are an easy mark being farmed by engagement algorithms and grifters.
An individual who mistakes algorithmic radicalization for secret enlightenment, treating the total absence of real-world evidence as proof of how deep the cover-up goes.
example: *"Bragging that he 'escaped the matrix' while parroting word-for-word talking points from a supplement-selling YouTube algorithm makes him a textbook **algodemic**."*
